import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
rng = random.Random(9)
nodes = ['n%02d'%i for i in range(64)]
caps = {n:512 for n in nodes}
flows = []
for i in range(64):
    flows.append(dict(id='f%03d'%i, path=rng.sample(nodes, 9), template='00'*16,
                      kinds='KKKDZQTKKKKKKKKK', labels=[16+ (i*9+j) for j in range(9)]))
events = []
# 20000 puts cycling over flows and nodes
for k in range(20000):
    f = flows[k % 64]
    node = f['path'][k % 9]
    events.append(dict(op='put', flow=f['id'], node=node))
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities=caps, flows=flows, events=events)
line = json.dumps(req)
open('/workspace/tmp/tables.json','w').write(line+'\n')
t0=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=line+'\n',capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
print('%.2fs'%(time.time()-t0), r.returncode, r.stdout[:80])
import json as J
d=J.loads(r.stdout)
print('tables', len(d['tables']), 'active', d['active'])
EOF
